messages:
Mira (People Ops): Quick heads-up — two folks dropping by around 3:15 who didn’t preregister: Alex and Sam. Can front desk have guest lanyards ready?
Jess (Front Desk): Yep we can. Will prep 2 lanyards and a sticker for the visitor sign-in. Do they have IDs?
Mira (People Ops): Alex said he’d bring his ID, Sam said she left hers in the studio but will show a photo. Is that OK?
Jess (Front Desk): Photo is fine for now, we’ll note it in the visitor log.
Tyler (Office Manager): Heads up — Conference B is booked at 3 for a prep call. If they need a quiet spot, the library table or the couch by the kitchen works.
Alex (Eng): Thanks — library table sounds great if it’s free. I’ll DM @Jess when we arrive.
Sam (Design): If we end up on the couch I’ll bring the whiteboard pad. Also small package arrived for me earlier — left in the mail slot.
Jess (Front Desk): Noted — found a small padded envelope addressed to Sam K. Marked and placed in the mail slot at 14:52.
Delivery Bot: Courier delivered 1 package for Sam K. Signature: Jess F. Tracking: 1Z999AA10123456784.
Mira (People Ops): Perfect, thanks all. Oh — can someone check the badge printer queue if Jess is tied up? Sometimes it stalls; quick fix is restart service:
Jess (Front Desk): On it. Quick command I run: `sudo systemctl restart badge-printer` — prints ok after that 90% of the time.
Tyler (Office Manager): If the badge printer chokes, there are extra spare lanyards in the supply closet (shelf B).
Alex (Eng): Appreciate it. See you in 10.
Sam (Design): Won’t be long — bringing donuts as bribery for couch reservations :donut:
Jess (Front Desk): Lol, I’ll keep an eye out. See you soon.
Mira (People Ops): Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
